patches.0001-gemm_-no-const.patch: Pyodide: SuperLU's gemm prototypes lose const (they must match the int-ABI BLAS); cert/lapack.mjs runs splu/spilu
patches.0002-make-int-return-values.patch: Pyodide: SuperLU, the g77 wrappers and _superlu_utils declare BLAS/LAPACK int; cert/lapack.mjs (splu, zdotc/cdotu)
patches.0003-Fix-gees-calls.patch: Pyodide: flapack's gees select callbacks take the int-ABI signature; cert/lapack.mjs runs linalg.schur
patches.0004-Remove-chla_transtype.patch: Pyodide: drops chla_transtype from cython_lapack (a char-returning LAPACK helper); cython_lapack links with --fatal-warnings and imports (cert/import.mjs)
patches.0005-Set-wrapper-return-type-to-int.patc: Pyodide: _generate_pyx.py declares cython_lapack/cython_blas's wrapped routines int; cython_lapack/cython_blas import (cert/import.mjs) and cert/lapack.mjs calls through them
patches.0006-superlu-blas-int-returns.patch: SuperLU 1.18's remaining void BLAS externs -> int; cert/lapack.mjs runs splu/spilu
patches.0007-Remove-xerbla_array.patch: drops xerbla_array from cython_lapack (OpenBLAS' f2c one has a hidden string length); cython_lapack links with --fatal-warnings and imports (cert/import.mjs)
patches.0008-no-test-npz.patch: skips scipy.special's test-data .npz generation (install_tag tests, needs numpy.loadtxt on the build python); build-only, no runtime effect (cert/import.mjs)
patches.0009-trlib-no-hidden-strlen.patch: trlib's dlagtm call loses gfortran's hidden string length; cert/lapack.mjs runs trust-krylov
patches.0010-uarray-call-signatures.patch: uarray's getters and BackendState._pickle get CPython's second parameter (homescoop#589); cert/uarray.mjs
